title: Fleet Labor Relief on Replacement Tire Mounting — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty
content:
**Crestline Fleet Account labor relief on replacement mounting — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty.** On the one-tire replacement ticket written for an adjusted tire, the mount-and-balance charge is relieved according to the vehicle's roster enrollment today:

| Vehicle today | Relieved from the line's mount-and-balance charge per tire |
|---|---|
| enrolled on the roster of an active Crestline Fleet Account | 15% |
| enrolled on the roster of a Crestline Fleet Account that is not active | 5% |
| any other vehicle | nothing |

A vehicle is enrolled today when it has a roster enrollment with no removal dated after it. Each relief on the mounting charge is worked out on its own, and the mounting charge less every relief taken off it is never below 0.

**Worked (hypothetical $29.00 charge):** active account — $4.35 relieved; account on hold or closed — $1.45 relieved.
